content: OWASP CSV Injection (owasp.org/www-community/attacks/CSV_Injection) + CWE-1236: cells starting with = + - @ (and tab/CR) can execute as spreadsheet formulas on open. Recommended mitigation: prefix such cells with a tab character (OWASP Excel-resistant) or apostrophe (CWE-1236, moderate). Applies to any user-controlled field written to CSV export (model, serial, notes, supplier, holder).
